KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Matamshi Bora Sauti, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Matamshi Bora Sauti.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. watoto
   B. kitoto
   C. mato
   D. mitoto

3. When practising Sarufi 1.4.1 Nomino, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

6. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito
